title: Jev Fervor Leads to Talk of Big Valuation Boost
summary: <p>Silicon Valley has a new AI startup to obsess over—and throw money at. We’re hearing that TypeSafe AI, the startup developing a new kind of model called Jev, has started to talk to investors about raising an enormous round—$1 billion or even more—and that some unnamed investors have offered to put money in at a valuation of $10 billion or more. All this for a startup that said only last week it had raised $40 million, at a valuation, according to PitchBook, of $200 million.&nbsp;&lt
